## Changes

- Scheduled event dispatch defaults to 20 passes per second, with configurable rate, event-count and time budgets. Pending events retain FIFO order across passes.
- Bounded event and trace queues with explicit overflow rejection reporting and on-demand `GetDispatchStats()` counters. Defaults allow 256 events or 2 ms per pass and 65,536 queued producer events; slow callbacks cannot be preempted.
- On-demand binding snapshots, stronger binding identity checks, and improved lifecycle regression coverage.
- Consistent product/version metadata, verified package allowlists and checksums, and release publication restricted to explicit versioned refs.

## Compatibility and validation

Windows x64, Unreal Engine 5.5 and UE4SS commit `97b7e501` only. API version remains 4. The release DLL uses the production component layout; the experimental layout128 Sandbox DLL is not included.

Automated native, Lua, packaging and runner checks accompany this release. A separate experimental-layout Sandbox build completed one Bridge/Baseline pair with 600/600 callbacks each. This does not certify the production DLL in every game or establish a performance advantage. No host-game acceptance run was performed for this release.

## Known limitation

When a Lua mod stops off the game thread, its callbacks are deactivated but helper-generated mapping contexts can remain installed. Close helper input scopes on the game thread before stopping/reloading the owning Lua mod where possible. Automatic off-thread context removal remains unresolved; this prerelease does not claim to fix it.

The ZIP contains only `UE4SSLuaEventBridge/enabled.txt` and `UE4SSLuaEventBridge/dlls/main.dll`. Its SHA-256 checksum and source-commit/file-hash manifest are separate release assets. Benchmark tools, internal records and third-party dependencies are excluded.
